summary: Re-tested /admin route after TDZ fix (iteration_10 regression). All critical checks PASS: /admin renders Admin Dashboard with full header and all 8 tabs; body text length 1660 chars (vs. previously 18 in blank state); Applications(10), Users(73), IP Bans(0) all populate; no TDZ / 'Cannot access before initialization' console errors; no pageerrors. Login → /admin → tab navigation → Logout flow works end-to-end; access_token cookie cleared on logout and user redirected to /login. Cookie-based auth round-trip verified.

integration_issues.issue: Two 401 errors logged in console during /admin load. Functionality is unaffected (all data loads, no toast shown), but the noise should be tracked. Likely caused by a request fired before currentUser resolves, or by /api/locations call (see code review below).

action_items: OPTIONAL CODE CLEANUP (not blocking): In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.js fetchData (lines ~74-91), the `axios.get('/api/locations')` block is INCORRECTLY NESTED inside the catch handler of the applications fetch. Result: locations are only fetched when applications fetch FAILS (and even then the inner try has no matching catch within the same scope — it relies on the outer catch). This is logically wrong but does not crash because syntax is valid. Recommend moving the locations fetch out to its own try/catch at the same level as `appsRes` and `usersRes`.

Investigate the two 401s during /admin initial load — likely a stale request firing before AuthContext resolves currentUser, or the misplaced /api/locations call hitting a non-existent / auth-required endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js fetchData has a structural bug: locations fetch nested inside applications-catch block (lines 75-91). Functionally broken — locations only attempted on application-fetch failure.

AdminDashboard.js is 1505 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Should be split into smaller components (e.g., extract ApplicationsTab, UsersTab, IpBansTab, LocationsTab, DatabaseSeedPanel into their own files).

TDZ fix itself is correct: currentUser is now sourced from useAuth() (line 30), and fetchData / fetchIpBans useCallbacks are declared before the useEffect that lists them in its deps array (lines 61-117 before line 119).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded data (10 pending applications, 73 users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_11 confirms the TDZ regression on /admin is fully resolved. /admin renders, all tabs work, login/logout flow works. The only follow-up item is a non-blocking code-cleanup issue: the /api/locations fetch inside fetchData is incorrectly nested inside the applications-catch block (see action_items). Two 401s appear on /admin load but do not impact UX or data loading. Backend was 14/14 PASS in iteration_10 and the cookie migration is signed off — no need to re-test backend.
rca of the issue: Iteration_10 root cause was a Temporal Dead Zone error: the useEffect at the top of AdminDashboard.js referenced fetchData / fetchIpBans / fetchCurrentUser in its dependency array BEFORE those useCallback declarations existed. The fix correctly (1) removed the local fetchCurrentUser entirely (currentUser now comes from useAuth() at line 30), and (2) moved fetchData (line 61) and fetchIpBans (line 110) declarations ABOVE the useEffect (line 119). Verified in this iteration: zero TDZ errors in console, page renders fully.
